summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Mast HedgeIndex Managed Futures Strategy ETF (HXF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in global macro alternatives.  The fund is an actively managed ETF that uses trend-following and macro strategies to take long and short positions across asset classes, markets, and geographies. The fund seeks positive absolute returns with low correlation to broad stock and bond markets. HXF was launched on Sep 1, 2026 and is issued by Mast.

completeness: holdings are every published row in the issuer's dated holdings CSV, which shares one Date
weights are the provider's signed Portfolio Weight values, kept exactly as published with no sum-to-100 check and no normalization of the cash line
Quantity is a mixed shares/contracts column, preserved as provider_quantity with its literal source label and no unit assertion
CUSIP or SEDOL is the row identifier and the issuer Ticker is a symbol only when it is a plain ticker; composite futures codes stay provider_ticker
market value, price, notional, NAV and history are not published in this file and stay null rather than being derived
